description: What the Celestia nodes that Unity Nodes runs actually use, measured on its own servers and shown beside Celestia's recommended hardware, from Unity Nodes Pulse: CPU cores, RAM of the processes, page cache, data size and its change per day, free disk and network for each node role (validator, consensus node, bridge, Fibre, light node), as median, 95th percentile and maximum over 1, 7 or 30 days. Measured values, with two clearly labelled estimates kept apart from them (a straight-line projection of each node's data size and the Celestia Foundation's Fibre calculator for Unity Nodes' voting power): a role Unity Nodes does not run is said to have no measurements (there is no Fibre on mainnet yet), the chain's own load in the same window (block data per second) with a correlation r of each node's CPU, network and disk load with it (a link in how they moved, not a cause; shown once four hours overlap), and the answer says how much of the window the samples fill, so early figures are provisional. For what Celestia's documentation requires, use search or get_doc ("Hardware requirements"); for servers that meet it, list_datacenter_offers; for an estimate of Fibre load, size_fibre_node. Celestia only.

role.description: Only this node role; all roles when left out

window.description: 1d, 7d or 30d: the span the median, 95th percentile and maximum cover

name: get_celestia_hardware_usage
